The '''Kinyen Emigration Office''' was a branch of the government of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. All [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who wanted to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had to first receive approval from the emigration office.<ref name="Strongholds" />
